WITH district_high_schools AS (
  SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.GSoffered,
    s.GSserved,
    s.StatusType,
    s.NCESDist
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12%'
),

sat_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.cds,
    SUM(sc.NumTstTakr) AS total_takers
  FROM satscores sc
  GROUP BY sc.cds
),

with_sat_join AS (
  SELECT 
    dh.CDSCode,
    dh.school_name,
    dh.GSoffered,
    dh.GSserved,
    IFNULL(sc.total_takers, 0) AS total_takers
  FROM district_high_schools dh
  LEFT JOIN sat_counts sc ON dh.CDSCode = sc.cds
  WHERE IFNULL(sc.total_takers, 0) = 0
),

--- Parse GSserved (e.g., 'KG-12', '09-12', 'PS-12', etc.)
min_grade AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(CASE 
          WHEN substr(GSserved, 1, 2) = 'PS' THEN 0
          WHEN substr(GSserved, 1, 2) = 'KG' THEN 1
          WHEN substr(GSserved, 1, 2) = 'TK' THEN 2
          ELSE CAST(substr(GSserved, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
        END) AS min_start_grade
  FROM with_sat_join
)

SELECT 
  wsj.school_name, 
  wsj.GSserved
FROM with_sat_join wsj
CROSS JOIN min_grade mg
WHERE (
  CASE 
    WHEN substr(wsj.GSserved, 1, 2) = 'PS' THEN 0
    WHEN substr(wsj.GSserved, 1, 2) = 'KG' THEN 1
    WHEN substr(wsj.GSserved, 1, 2) = 'TK' THEN 2
    ELSE CAST(substr(wsj.GSserved, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
  END
) = mg.min_start_grade
ORDER BY wsj.school_name ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.FundingType,
    f.[Enrollment (K-12)] AS enrollment,
    f.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)] AS frpm_pct
  FROM schools s
  INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Charter = 1
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND f.[Academic Year] = '2014-15'
    AND f.[Charter Funding Type] IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
),
sat_combined AS (
  SELECT 
    cds, 
    COALESCE(AvgScrRead,0) + COALESCE(AvgScrMath,0) + COALESCE(AvgScrWrite,0) AS combined_sat
  FROM satscores
  WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    b.FundingType,
    COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
    SUM(b.enrollment) AS total_enrollment,
    ROUND(AVG(b.frpm_pct),2) AS avg_frpm_pct
  FROM base b
  GROUP BY b.FundingType
)
SELECT 
  a.FundingType,
  a.num_schools,
  a.total_enrollment,
  a.avg_frpm_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(s.combined_sat),2) AS avg_combined_sat
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN base b ON a.FundingType = b.FundingType
LEFT JOIN sat_combined s ON b.CDSCode = s.cds
GROUP BY a.FundingType, a.num_schools, a.total_enrollment, a.avg_frpm_pct
ORDER BY a.FundingType;

WITH ca_special_schools AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode AS cdscode,
    School AS name,
    GSoffered AS grades_offered
  FROM schools
  WHERE State = 'CA'
    AND DOCType = 'State Special'
    AND StatusType = 'Active'
),
special_schools_processed AS (
  SELECT
    cdscode,
    name,
    -- extract earliest grade in the order: P, K, 1, 2, ..., 12
    LOWER(TRIM(CASE
      WHEN instr(grades_offered, ',') = 0 THEN grades_offered
      ELSE substr(grades_offered, 1, instr(grades_offered || ',', ',') - 1)
    END)) AS earliest_grade
  FROM ca_special_schools
),
grade_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    cdscode,
    name,
    earliest_grade,
    CASE
      WHEN earliest_grade = 'p' THEN 0
      WHEN earliest_grade = 'k' THEN 1
      WHEN earliest_grade GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(earliest_grade AS INTEGER) + 1
      ELSE 100
    END AS grade_rank
  FROM special_schools_processed
),
enrollments AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN GSserved GLOB '*K*' OR
             GSserved GLOB '*1*' OR
             GSserved GLOB '*2*' OR
             GSserved GLOB '*3*' OR
             GSserved GLOB '*4*' OR
             GSserved GLOB '*5*' OR
             GSserved GLOB '*6*' OR
             GSserved GLOB '*7*' OR
             GSserved GLOB '*8*' OR
             GSserved GLOB '*9*' OR
             GSserved GLOB '*10*' OR
             GSserved GLOB '*11*' OR
             GSserved GLOB '*12*'
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS k12_enrollment
  FROM schools
  WHERE State = 'CA'
    AND DOCType = 'State Special'
    AND StatusType = 'Active'
  GROUP BY CDSCode
),
sat_counts AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    SUM(NumTstTakr) AS sat_test_takers
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'S'
  GROUP BY cds
)
SELECT
  g.name AS school_name,
  g.earliest_grade,
  COALESCE(e.k12_enrollment, 0) AS k12_enrollment,
  COALESCE(s.sat_test_takers, 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM grade_ranked g
LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON g.cdscode = e.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN sat_counts s ON g.cdscode = s.cds
ORDER BY g.grade_rank DESC, k12_enrollment DESC, school_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  f."Charter Funding Type" AS funding_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f."CDSCode") AS num_schools_operating,
  SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_k12_enrollment,
  SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS total_k12_frpm_eligible
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f."CDSCode"
WHERE f."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
  AND (s.DOCType = 'County Office of Education')
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY f."Charter Funding Type"
ORDER BY CASE f."Charter Funding Type"
           WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
           WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
           ELSE 3
         END

WITH HomeWins AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS match_id,
    m.home_team_api_id,
    m.away_team_api_id,
    m.date AS match_date,
    m.home_team_goal,
    m.away_team_goal
  FROM Match m
  WHERE (m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal) >= 3
),
LatestAttributes AS (
  SELECT
    hw.match_id,
    hw.home_team_api_id,
    ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY hw.match_id
      ORDER BY ta.date DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM HomeWins hw
  JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON ta.team_api_id = hw.home_team_api_id AND ta.date <= hw.match_date
),
WinsWithFastBuildUp AS (
  SELECT
    la.match_id,
    la.home_team_api_id
  FROM LatestAttributes la
  WHERE la.rn = 1 AND la.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
)
SELECT
  t.team_long_name AS club_name,
  t.team_short_name AS short_name,
  COUNT(*) AS home_fast_win_count
FROM WinsWithFastBuildUp w
JOIN Team t ON w.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
GROUP BY w.home_team_api_id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
HAVING home_fast_win_count = (
  SELECT MAX(club_counts.cnt) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM WinsWithFastBuildUp w2
    GROUP BY w2.home_team_api_id
  ) AS club_counts
)
ORDER BY club_name

treatment.sql:
WITH match_home_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    m.id AS match_id,
    m.date AS match_date,
    m.home_team_api_id,
    m.away_team_api_id,
    m.home_team_goal,
    m.away_team_goal,
    m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal AS goal_diff
  FROM Match m
  WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
), 
last_speed_attr AS (
  SELECT ta.team_api_id, ta.date AS attr_date, ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id, ta.date ORDER BY ta.date DESC, ta.id DESC) rn
  FROM Team_Attributes ta
),
team_attr_at_match AS (
  SELECT mw.match_id, mw.home_team_api_id,
         (
           SELECT ta2.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
           FROM Team_Attributes ta2
           WHERE ta2.team_api_id = mw.home_team_api_id
             AND date(ta2.date) <= date(mw.match_date)
           ORDER BY date(ta2.date) DESC, ta2.id DESC
           LIMIT 1
         ) AS buildUpPlaySpeedClass
  FROM match_home_wins mw
),
fast_home_wins AS (
  SELECT tam.match_id, tam.home_team_api_id
  FROM team_attr_at_match tam
  WHERE tam.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
),
club_win_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    t.id,
    t.team_long_name,
    t.team_short_name,
    COUNT(fhw.match_id) AS fast_home_wins
  FROM fast_home_wins fhw
  JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = fhw.home_team_api_id
  GROUP BY t.id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
)
SELECT team_long_name AS club_name, team_short_name, fast_home_wins
FROM club_win_counts
WHERE fast_home_wins = (SELECT MAX(fast_home_wins) FROM club_win_counts)
   OR fast_home_wins >= 1
ORDER BY fast_home_wins DESC, club_name
LIMIT 1000

    FROM trans
    WHERE type = 'transfer' AND bank IS NOT NULL AND BANK != '' AND account IS NOT NULL

    owner_district_id,

    GROUP BY d.account_id
),
loan_info AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_defaulted,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_repaying,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_paid
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_status_label AS (
    SELECT account_id,
        CASE 
          WHEN loan_count = 0 THEN 'no loan'
          WHEN any_defaulted > 0 THEN 'defaulted'
          WHEN any_repaying > 0 THEN 'repaying'
          ELSE 'paid off'
        END AS loan_status
    FROM loan_info
),
transaction_sums AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') AS txn_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' AND date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'withdrawal') AND date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
peak_balance AS (
    SELECT account_id, 
           COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' THEN balance ELSE NULL END), 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
balance_ranks AS (
    SELECT account_id, peak_balance, 
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC, account_id ASC) AS peak_balance_rank
    FROM peak_balance
)
SELECT ta.account_id, ta.opened_date, oa.gender, oa.age_at_1996_12_31 AS age, 
       COALESCE(cc.card_count,0) AS num_cards,
       COALESCE(li.loan_count,0) AS num_loans,
       COALESCE(ls.loan_status, 'no loan') AS loan_status,
       COALESCE(ts.txn_count, 0) AS txn_1997_count,
       COALESCE(ts.money_in, 0) AS money_in_1997,
       COALESCE(ts.money_out, 0) AS money_out_1997,
       COALESCE(pb.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance_1997,
       COALESCE(br.peak_balance_rank, 0) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM tabor_accounts ta
LEFT JOIN owner_age oa ON ta.account_id = oa.account_id
LEFT JOIN card_counts cc ON ta.account_id = cc.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_info li ON ta.account_id = li.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_status_label ls ON ta.account_id = ls.account_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_sums ts ON ta.account_id = ts.account_id
LEFT JOIN peak_balance pb ON ta.account_id = pb.account_id
LEFT JOIN balance_ranks br ON ta.account_id = br.account_id
ORDER BY br.peak_balance_rank ASC, ta.account_id ASC
LIMIT 1000

  FROM qualifying

      /* q1 times are stored as mm:ss.sss or h:mm:ss.sss or NULL; we must convert to seconds. */

      )
      OR
      -- Convert 'mm:ss.sss' to seconds and check < 120

WITH race_local_times AS (

    races.raceId,

  SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
  FROM race_local_times, min_max_times

),

  WHERE local_start_time = latest_time
)

  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuitRef) FROM earliest_circuits) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuitRef) FROM latest_circuits) AS latest_circuit_refs,
  CAST((strftime('%s', latest_time) - strftime('%s', earliest_time)) AS INTEGER) AS seconds_gap
FROM min_max_times

JOIN Laboratory pro ON p.ID = pro.ID
WHERE 
  ldh.LDH >= 500
  AND (
    -- Check for numeric U-PRO or >=pattern or value in parentheses
    (
      -- Direct numeric value (ignoring '-', 'TR', etc.)
      pro.U_PRO GLOB '[0-9]*'
      AND CAST(pro.U_PRO AS INTEGER) >= 100
    )
    OR (
      -- Value in parentheses, e.g. '+2(100)'
      pro.U_PRO LIKE '%(%)'
      AND
      CAST(
        SUBSTR(
          pro.U_PRO,
          INSTR(pro.U_PRO, '(') + 1,
          INSTR(pro.U_PRO, ')') - INSTR(pro.U_PRO, '(') - 1
        ) AS INTEGER
      ) >= 100
    )
    OR (
      -- >=numeric pattern, e.g. '>=300'
      pro.U_PRO LIKE '>=%'
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(pro.U_PRO, 3) AS INTEGER) >= 100
    )
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

        b.molecule_id,

                WHEN a1.element = 'C' OR a2.element = 'C' THEN 1
                ELSE 0

    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE 1=0 -- Prevent cross join explosion, as correct key not present
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id

FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND LOWER(a.element) IN ('na','k','ca','cu','zn','sn','pb','mg','li')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bond b2 WHERE b2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b2.bond_type != '-'
  )
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

baseline.sql:
WITH atom_bond_types AS (
  SELECT
    a.element,
    a.atom_id,
    COUNT(c.bond_id) AS total_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type != '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
  FROM atom a
  JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.element
)
SELECT
  element,
  COUNT(*) AS saturated_atom_count
FROM atom_bond_types
WHERE
  total_bonds >= 1
  AND total_bonds = single_bonds
  AND multiple_bonds = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;

treatment.sql:
WITH bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT
    a.atom_id,
    a.element,
    COUNT(c.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type != '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bond_count
  FROM atom a
  JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.element
)
SELECT
  element,
  COUNT(*) AS fully_saturated_atom_count
FROM bonded_atoms
WHERE bond_count > 0
  AND multiple_bond_count = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;

baseline.sql:
WITH triple_bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id, a.element
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
)
SELECT 
  element AS element_symbol, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS num_molecules
FROM triple_bond_atoms
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY num_molecules DESC, element_symbol ASC;

treatment.sql:
WITH triple_bond_ids AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, bond_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '#'
),
all_atoms AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, substr(bond_id, 1, instr(bond_id, '-')-1) AS atom_id
  FROM triple_bond_ids
  UNION ALL
  SELECT molecule_id, substr(bond_id, instr(bond_id, '-')+1) AS atom_id
  FROM triple_bond_ids
)
SELECT
  a.element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM all_atoms aa
JOIN atom a ON aa.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND aa.atom_id = a.atom_id
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;
